purpose: Measure the effect of this lane's interpretive choices on the v4 seat set

S1_N_for_first_seat.reading: The first seat wins on D=1.0 (20 points, fixed by rule for the first pick) plus C; the N grant is not what selects it. Even at N=0.5 it stays ahead of seat 2.

S2_N_cap.note: N=1 arises only for the two generation methods present (site1/site2), so at most 2 seats can earn it; the rest are 0.5 or 0.

N_is_screening_coverage.reading: N=0 for a seat means 'nobody screened this design', not 'this design is not novel'. Of the 20 seats, most score N=0 for that reason alone. Any use of S to claim one seat is more novel than another is unsupported by this data.
